commitments.detail: All project handoffs will be conducted via email.
Project handoffs will include a detailed document outlining all necessary information and context.
Eli and Dana will respond to handoff emails within 24 hours.
This agreement will be in effect for the next 12 weeks.
Unscheduled one-on-one meetings are not allowed under this agreement.
Any issues arising from the handoff process can be resolved through an informal meeting between the two parties.
If either party needs to schedule a repair meeting, they must provide at least 48 hours notice.
